composition_notes: Use the same canvas origin and scale for all layers. Do not trim overlays individually.
For tight tiling use the common [8,8,240,240] content region consistently on every layer.
At depth2 show only the generic buried clue; keep actual artifact hidden.
At depth1 fit external artifact artwork in the opening, then draw the transparent edge overlay above it.
The opening is an edge treatment, not a clipping mask: it cannot erase soil or clip oversized artifact artwork.
At depth0 remove burial hints and display external artifact artwork if present.
No Golden Mask, other identifiable artifact, revealed-artifact state, or occupied block is baked into these PNGs.
